title: [Bug]: DocumentBlock doesn't work with BedrockConverse
body:
### Bug Description

Trying to use DocumentBlock in Bedrock converse but failing due to an unexpected error.

### Version

llama-index-0.12.37 llama-index-llms-bedrock-converse ( 0.5.4)

### Steps to Reproduce

```
from llama_index.core.llms import ChatMessage, DocumentBlock, MessageRole, TextBlock
from llama_index.llms.bedrock_converse import BedrockConverse


llm = BedrockConverse(
    model="anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0",
)
msg = ChatMessage(role=MessageRole.USER, blocks=[DocumentBlock(path="Cushman.pdf"), TextBlock(text="What does this file contain?")])

messages = [msg]
response = llm.chat(messages)
print(response.message.blocks[0].text)
```

linked_prs.title: Fixing DocumentBlock usage within Bedrock Converse
linked_prs.body:
# Description

We now use `txt` as enforced document type, since that is the only type that seems to be inferred by Bedrock and using a different one causes a validation error.
We are also using decoded bytes instead of b64-encoded bytes, since Bedrock seems to be working only with them.

Fixes #18789
